Hubbard |chapter= |title=The Quiet River |edition=republished |publisher=Orion Publishing Group |isbn=9781471900785 |url=https://www.google.com/books/edition/The_Quiet_River/npk4AgAAQBAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&dq=%22stores%22&pg=PT73&printsec=frontcover |passage=She saw that there were cattle grazing on two of the fields between her and the river. At this time of the year the heifers and '''stores''' looked grown beasts at this distance.
